# MALDI-MSI data preparation 

## Software requirments 

```{r, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(foreach)
library(circlize)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(scater)
library(BiocParallel)
library(Cardinal)
```


## 1. Read in data 

```{r}
mse_1 <- readMSIData("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/metabolome/new_data/raw/ztma_20_rcc_no_normalized_complete_spectrum.imzML", as = "MSImagingExperiment")
mse_2 <- readMSIData("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/metabolome/new_data/raw/ztma_224_rcc_no_normalized_complete_spectrum.imzML", as = "MSImagingExperiment")

mse_1
mse_2
```


```{r}
# Spectra data
spectraData(mse_1)
spectra(mse_1, "intensity")

# Pixel data
pixelData(mse_1)
pixelData(mse_2)
coord(mse_1)[,"z"] <- as.numeric(coord(mse_1)[,"z"])
coord(mse_2)[,"z"] <- as.numeric(coord(mse_2)[,"z"])

# Runnames
runNames(mse_1)

# Features
featureData(mse_1)
```

```{r}
# Plot 
## Different spectra numbers
plot(mse_1, i=c(10, 100))
plot(mse_1, i=c(10, 100), xlim=c(300, 400), ylim=c(0,10000000),
    superpose=TRUE)

# Image
image(mse_1, mz = 199.007)
image(mse_2, mz = 199.007)
```

## 2. Preprocessing 

### Basic 

```{r}
# Remove z-axis (always 1)
coord(mse_1) <- coord(mse_1)[ , c("x", "y")]
coord(mse_2) <- coord(mse_2)[ , c("x", "y")]
```

### Segmentation 

TMA 20 

```{r}
## TMA20 

library(igraph)

df <- pData(mse_1)

# Build a lookup for faster neighbor search
key <- paste(df$x, df$y, sep = "_")
idx_lookup <- match(key, key)

# For each pixel, find its 4-neighbors (up/down/left/right)
neighbors <- function(i) {
  x <- df$x[i]
  y <- df$y[i]
  nbrs <- paste(
    c(x+1, x-1, x,   x),
    c(y,   y,   y+1, y-1),
    sep = "_"
  )
  match(nbrs, key)
}

# Build edges between each pixel and its neighbors
edges <- 
  lapply(seq_len(nrow(df)), function(i) {
    nbs <- neighbors(i)
    nbs <- nbs[!is.na(nbs)]
    if (length(nbs))
      rbind(rep(i, length(nbs)), nbs)
  })

edges <- do.call(cbind, edges)

# Create graph
g <- graph_from_edgelist(t(edges), directed = FALSE)

# Connected component IDs
comp <- components(g)$membership

# Back to the MSIexperiment object:
pData(mse_1)$object_id <- as.character(comp)

# Visualize
image(mse_1, "object_id")
```




```{r}
# Filter segmented objects based on size 
size_objects <- pData(mse_1) %>% as.data.frame %>% group_by(object_id) %>% dplyr::count()

size_objects <- size_objects %>% mutate(check = ifelse(n < 80 | n > 210, TRUE, FALSE))

# Add to MSI
mse_1$check <- size_objects$check[match(mse_1$object_id, size_objects$object_id)]
image(mse_1, "object_id")

# Filter objects
mse_1_fil <- mse_1[mse_1$check == FALSE]
image(mse_1_fil, "object_id")
```


```{r}
# Export segmentation image for annotation
plot <- pData(mse_1_fil) %>% as.data.frame

centroids <- plot %>% 
  group_by(object_id) %>%
  summarise(
    x = mean(x),
    y = mean(y)
  )

pdf("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/metabolome/new_data/data_analysis/TMA20_seg_image.pdf", width = 12, height = 5)
ggplot(plot, aes(x, y, fill = factor(object_id))) +
  scale_x_reverse() + 
  geom_tile() +
  geom_text(data = centroids, 
            aes(x, y, label = object_id),
            color = "black",
            size = 4) +
  theme_minimal()+
  guides(fill = "none")
dev.off()


anno <- pData(mse_1_fil) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(run, object_id) %>% unique() %>% remove_rownames() %>% mutate(object_id = as.numeric(object_id)) %>% arrange(-object_id) %>% mutate(object_id = as.character(object_id))
write_csv(anno, "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/metabolome/new_data/data_analysis/TMA20_seg_anno.csv")
```

### Normalization, Recalibration, Smoothing, Peak picking, Peak align

```{r}
# TMA20
peaks_drift_1 <- estimateReferencePeaks(mse_1)

mse_1_recab <- process(
  recalibrate(mse_1, ref = peaks_drift_1, method="locmax", tolerance=50, units="ppm")
  )

mse_1_proc_SNR20 <- mse_1_recab  |> 
  normalize(method="rms") |> 
  smooth() |> 
  peakPick(method = "filter", SNR = 2)

mse_1_proc_SNR20_aligned <- peakAlign(mse_1_proc_SNR20)

saveRDS(mse_1_proc_SNR20_aligned, "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/metabolome/new_data/data_analysis/TM20_picked_SNR20.rds")


# TMA224
peaks_drift_2 <- estimateReferencePeaks(mse_2)

mse_2_recab <- process(
  recalibrate(mse_2, ref = peaks_drift_2, method="locmax", tolerance=50, units="ppm")
  )

mse_2_proc_SNR20 <- mse_2_recab |> 
  normalize(method="rms") |> 
  smooth() |> 
  peakPick(method = "filter", SNR = 2)

mse_2_proc_SNR20_aligned <- peakAlign(mse_2_proc_SNR20)

saveRDS(mse_2_proc_SNR20_aligned, "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/metabolome/new_data/data_analysis/TM224_picked_SNR20.rds")
```

### Common mz grid 

```{r}
mse_1_proc_SNR25_aligned <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/metabolome/new_data/data_analysis/TM20_aligned_SNR25.rds")

mse_test <- mse_1_proc_SNR25_aligned
```

```{r}
# Round mz values to find common grid
mz(mse_2_proc_SNR25_aligned) <- round(mz(mse_2_proc_SNR25_aligned), 3)
mz(mse_1_proc_SNR25_aligned) <- round(mz(mse_1_proc_SNR25_aligned), 3)

mz_grid <- intersect(mz(mse_1_proc_SNR25_aligned), mz(mse_2_proc_SNR25_aligned))

# Subset to common grid
mse_2_proc_SNR25_aligned <- subsetFeatures(mse_2_proc_SNR25_aligned, mz %in% mz_grid)
mse_1_proc_SNR25_aligned <- subsetFeatures(mse_1_proc_SNR25_aligned, mz %in% mz_grid)


# Combine
mse_combined <- cbind(mse_2_proc_SNR25_aligned, mse_1_proc_SNR25_aligned)
fData(mse_combined)

# Subset features
mse_combined
```



```{r}
pData <- pData(mse_combined) %>% as.data.frame
```

```{r}
image(mse_combined, mz=mz_grid[100])
```

```{r}
# Mean feature intensities
mean_1 <- summarizeFeatures(mse_1_proc_SNR30_filtered, stat="mean")

mean_2 <- summarizeFeatures(mse_2_proc_SNR30_filtered, stat="mean")

mean_df <- rbind(fData(mean_1) %>% as.data.frame %>% mutate(data = "TMA20"), fData(mean_2) %>% as.data.frame %>% mutate(data = "TMA224"))

ggplot(mean_df, aes(mz, mean, color = data))+
  geom_line(alpha = 0.5)+
  theme_classic()

ggplot(mean_df %>% filter(mz < 400 & mz > 350), aes(mz, mean, color = data))+
  geom_line()+
  theme_classic()

ggplot(mean_df %>% filter(mz < 250 & mz > 200), aes(mz, mean, color = data))+
  geom_line()+
  theme_classic()

ggplot(mean_df %>% filter(mz < 550 & mz > 540), aes(mz, mean, color = data))+
  geom_line()+
  theme_classic()
```
